theme: Graphite, async readback, and Skia m152
highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 introduces the Graphite GPU backend, async pixel readback, and upgrades to Skia milestone m152.
highlights_body: This release adds Vulkan/Metal/Dawn Graphite bindings, backend-neutral async pixel readback, a new Vulkan.Silk.NET package, and Nano Server font support via FreeType. It also fixes several native memory-safety bugs and ships a batch of managed-code performance improvements.

bullets.detail: The bundled Skia engine is now built from Chrome milestone m152, and several upstream chrome/m151 stability fixes were merged before the upgrade.

bullets.lead: Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn
bullets.detail: SkiaSharp now exposes Skia's next-generation Graphite GPU backend across Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn, alongside a new SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package for Vulkan interop via Silk.NET.
SKImage and SKSurface gain RequestReadPixels, an async, backend-neutral API for reading back pixels without blocking the calling thread.

bullets.lead: Nano Server font support via FreeType
bullets.detail: Text rendering on Windows Nano Server containers now uses FreeType for font loading, enabling SkiaSharp to run in minimal container images that lack the usual Windows font stack.

bullets.lead: Native use-after-free fixes in SKRegion and SKPixmap
bullets.detail: SKRegion.SpanIterator no longer leaves a dangling native pointer after its owning SKRegion is collected, and SKPixmap.ExtractSubset and With* now root their source pixel buffer to prevent a use-after-free.

bullets.lead: CoTaskMem pixel-buffer leak fixed in SKImage.Create failure path
bullets.detail: A native memory leak that occurred when SKImage.Create failed to create a raster image from a pixel buffer has been fixed.

bullets.lead: Managed-code performance improvements across several hot paths
bullets.detail: HandleDictionary's skip-registration reflection check is now cached, GetEncodedText avoids an intermediate string allocation on its null-terminated path, SKRuntimeEffectUniforms pre-sizes its uniform lookup map, and SKData.SaveTo avoids a double buffer copy.
A new package adds Vulkan interop bindings built on Silk.NET, with Vulkan tests now running on Android and Linux.
The generated P/Invoke bindings are now produced deterministically regardless of the host platform used to build them.

v4.152.0-preview.1.1.subtitle: Introduces the Graphite GPU backend, async pixel readback, and Skia milestone 152.
v4.152.0-preview.1.1.website_summary: Preview 1 introduces Graphite, async pixel readback, Nano Server font support, and Skia milestone 152.

bullets.text: Added Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn.
Added a backend-neutral async RequestReadPixels API to SKImage and SKSurface.
Added Nano Server font support via FreeType.
Fixed native use-after-free bugs in SKRegion.SpanIterator and SKPixmap.
Fixed a CoTaskMem pixel-buffer leak in the SKImage.Create raster failure path.
Added the SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package and ran Vulkan tests on Android and Linux.
Upgraded the Skia engine to Chrome milestone m152.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1 ships with this release with no API changes; the touched PRs were solution-format and CI infrastructure work.
